text: The persons with significant control of JOTA Motorsport Limited (Companies House 03890719) are Samuel John Hignett and Kelly Gabriella Hignett, each with ownership of shares of more than 25% but not more than 50%; Kent Online reported in 2016 that founder Sam Hignett co-owns JOTA Sport.
short: JOTA Motorsport Limited's registered owners are Samuel John and Kelly Gabriella Hignett.
